v14_adt001_probe.description: Reproduction attempt for ADT-001. Summons a named pig and, in the same tick, resolves it four ways: entities nearby, @e by name, @e by type and radius, and vanilla kill-free inspection. The reported failure was @e matching nothing right after entities nearby listed the pig. stopOnFailure is off so every probe runs even if one fails.

v14_adt001_delayed.description: The same selector one second later, to separate a same-tick problem from a general one.

v14_adt001_cleanup.description: Removes the probe pig through the vanilla path, which also proves whether vanilla resolves the same selector, then stops the session.
